biggest_catch: Rover's official support confirms sitters are paid within days of a completed service - but sitters set their own rates, so Rover publishes no concrete worker pay figure.
catches: No official concrete worker pay figure: sitters set their own rates, so earnings are per-sitter not per-platform.
Rover takes a service fee cut from the sitter's earnings (15-20% per third-party reports).
Payout timing is within 5 working days of service end - not instant.
Off-platform cash payments violate Rover's terms and void the Rover Guarantee.
Earnings depend on bookings - no guaranteed request flow.
